# Mother Lode Detailing

> Auto detailing and ceramic coatings for sedans, trucks, and SUVs in Calaveras County and Lodi, California. Paint correction is coming soon. Call or text (559) 505-5164 for a quote.

Prices below are starting prices. The final price depends on the vehicle's condition (dirt, pet hair, stains). Customers send a few photos and get an exact price before any work starts.

## Services and starting prices

- Exterior detail (foam pre-wash, hand wash, wheels, tires, and glass): sedan $80, truck $100, SUV $100
- Interior detail (vacuum, wipe-down, seats and carpet spot-treated, inside glass): sedan $140, truck $140, SUV $160
- Full inside and out (exterior and interior in one visit): from $200
- Ceramic coating (a hard, glossy layer so dirt and water slide off): $750 to $1,200
- Paint correction, coming soon (full-body machine polishing for swirls, light scratches, and dull or oxidized paint): from $400
- Add-ons for any service: pet hair removal, engine bay, headlight restoration, clay bar, seat shampoo, odor treatment

## Service area

Calaveras County and Lodi, California, along Highways 4, 49, 26, and 12:

- Highway 4: Copperopolis, Vallecito, Murphys, Avery, Hathaway Pines, Arnold
- Highway 49: Angels Camp, San Andreas, Mokelumne Hill
- Highways 12 and 26: Lodi, Valley Springs, Glencoe, West Point

Customers just over the line in Amador or Tuolumne County can ask.

The business can come to the customer (mobile), or the customer can drop the vehicle off. Starting prices are the same in every town, with no extra travel charge.

## How booking works

1. Text or email photos of the inside and outside, with the year, make, and model.
2. Get a quote and the next open days.
3. Pick a day and get the vehicle back clean.

- Booking form: https://motherlodedetailing.com/#book
- Call or text: (559) 505-5164
- Email: arias.riley@yahoo.com
